title: Fix follow button functionality and follower count display

requirements.text: Ensure the backend follow/unfollow functions correctly persist the follow relationship between users, storing follower and following associations in stable state, and expose accurate follower/following count queries.
acceptanceCriteria: Calling the follow function with a valid principal saves the relationship persistently
Calling the unfollow function removes the relationship
getFollowerCount and getFollowingCount return accurate counts after follow/unfollow operations
isFollowing query returns true after following and false after unfollowing

requirements.text: Fix the follow/unfollow button on the UserProfilePage so that tapping it triggers the backend follow/unfollow mutation, shows a loading state during the call, updates the button label (Follow ↔ Following) upon success, and refreshes the displayed follower/following counts immediately after the action.
acceptanceCriteria: Tapping the Follow button triggers a backend follow call and the button enters a loading/disabled state
After a successful follow, the button label changes to 'Following' and follower count increments by 1
Tapping the Following button triggers a backend unfollow call and the button reverts to 'Follow' with follower count decremented by 1
Follower and following counts on the profile page reflect the updated values without requiring a page reload
If the backend call fails, an error toast is shown and the button state reverts

requirements.text: Wire up the follow/unfollow React Query mutation hooks in useQueries.ts to correctly call the backend actor's follow and unfollow methods, and invalidate the relevant profile and follower count queries on success.
acceptanceCriteria: useFollowUser and useUnfollowUser mutation hooks exist in useQueries.ts and call the correct backend actor methods
On mutation success, queries for the target user's profile and follower/following counts are invalidated and refetched
The isFollowing status is also refetched after follow/unfollow

constraints: Do not change the overall UI layout of UserProfilePage beyond the follow button and count display
All backend logic must remain in the single main actor file (backend/main.mo)
nonGoals: Mutual follow approval flows — following should be one-sided and immediate
Follow notifications are out of scope for this fix
Changes to any immutable frontend paths (useInternetIdentity, useActor, main.tsx, ui components)
